name: Adolphe
source:
[i]"It's disappointing to see that the nature of humans hasn't changed."[/i]

[i]Affirming his fate to pursue.[/i]

The leader of the Corps who was raised alongside the heroine at the orphanage. He currently lives alone on the outskirts of town. He can be brusque at times, but is a kind soul deep down who won't turn his back on anyone in need. He is seen as a reliable brother to the heroine.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Leader of the Corps

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
